{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam GROUPS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam PAD = GROUPS * 4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(GROUPS);

    wire sub_ab = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire sub_ba = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire subtract = sub_ab | sub_ba;
    wire arithmetic = (Oper == 3'b000) | sub_ab | sub_ba;
    wire select_or = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire select_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire select_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire select_xnor = (Oper == 3'b110);

    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_xor = a ^ b;
    wire [PAD-1:0] p, g;
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] prefix_p [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] prefix_g [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] result;

    genvar i, k, s;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PAD; i = i + 1) begin: leaves
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: active
                assign p[i] = bit_xor[i] ^ subtract;
                assign g[i] = (a[i] ^ sub_ba) & (b[i] ^ sub_ab);
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end

        for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k + 1) begin: groups
            wire [3:0] lp;
            wire [3:0] lg;
            wire [3:0] carry;
            assign lp = p[4*k +: 4];
            assign lg = g[4*k +: 4];
            assign prefix_p[0][k] = &lp;
            assign prefix_g[0][k] = lg[3]
                | (lp[3] & lg[2])
                | (lp[3] & lp[2] & lg[1])
                | (lp[3] & lp[2] & lp[1] & lg[0]);

            if (k == 0) begin: first
                assign carry[0] = subtract;
            end else begin: following
                assign carry[0] = prefix_g[LEVELS][k-1]
                    | (prefix_p[LEVELS][k-1] & subtract);
            end
            assign carry[1] = lg[0] | (lp[0] & carry[0]);
            assign carry[2] = lg[1] | (lp[1] & lg[0])
                | (lp[1] & lp[0] & carry[0]);
            assign carry[3] = lg[2] | (lp[2] & lg[1])
                | (lp[2] & lp[1] & lg[0])
                | (lp[2] & lp[1] & lp[0] & carry[0]);

            for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin: local_sum
                if (4*k+i < WIDTH) begin: active
                    assign arithmetic_result[4*k+i] = lp[i] ^ carry[i];
                end
            end
        end

        for (s = 0; s < LEVELS; s = s + 1) begin: prefix_levels
            for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k + 1) begin: nodes
                if (k >= (1 << s)) begin: combine
                    assign prefix_g[s+1][k] = prefix_g[s][k]
                        | (prefix_p[s][k] & prefix_g[s][k-(1 << s)]);
                    assign prefix_p[s+1][k] = prefix_p[s][k]
                        & prefix_p[s][k-(1 << s)];
                end else begin: pass
                    assign prefix_g[s+1][k] = prefix_g[s][k];
                    assign prefix_p[s+1][k] = prefix_p[s][k];
                end
            end
        end

        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin: output_bits
            assign result[i] = (arithmetic & arithmetic_result[i])
                | (select_or & (a[i] | b[i]))
                | (select_and & (a[i] & b[i]))
                | (select_xor & bit_xor[i])
                | (select_xnor & ~bit_xor[i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    always @* begin
        sum = result;
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "Wide arithmetic carry propagation and the selection among three arithmetic results are the likely maximum-arrival bottlenecks.",
  "rewrite": "Share one arithmetic datapath across addition and both subtraction directions. Selectively complement the operands and inject the subtraction carry. Use four-bit lookahead groups with a logarithmic parallel-prefix network between groups, followed by direct local carry equations. Merge arithmetic and logical results with mutually exclusive decoded masks.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The 64-bit configuration has sixteen carry groups and four inter-group prefix levels, avoiding a long ripple carry chain. Sharing arithmetic also removes selection among three separate arithmetic results. A numerical gain requires measurement with the specified mapping and interface constraints; no STA result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The prefix network adds carry-combination wiring and cells, while sharing the arithmetic datapath reduces duplication. The four-bit grouping limits prefix size relative to a full bit-level network. Compliance with the 13121.834880um2 cap and electrical limits requires mapped evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Combinational and stateless. For every binary input, operations 000 through 110 retain their original unsigned WIDTH-bit results, including modulo-2^WIDTH arithmetic truncation; 111 produces zero. The module name, ports, output reg declaration, and WIDTH parameter are preserved. Partial final groups are handled using neutral padding. No helper modules, assumptions, undefined outputs, or added latency are used."
}
